scopeNotes: Existing 23 line identities preserved; historical production cars and light commercials included, no motorcycles or Acura-only nameplates.
Each version from/to remains null: source model-year availability does not establish full production range.
Primary OEM European tables were read through cached web search because live Honda newsroom URLs returned403. No full source prose or tables retained.
2012 Civic OEM page contains internally inconsistent dimensions block: dimensions/mass/consumption/performance withheld.
Civic2017 provisional dimensions conflict with later ADAC values: conflicting length/width/height withheld.
CR-V2015 provisional length4570 differs from later4605: length withheld. Mirror-inclusive width2096 is not presented as body width.
Accord2008 pre-launch/magazine length and wheelbase conflict: withheld. 2.4 torque233/234 conflict: withheld. Published kW used directly; no horsepower or mph conversion.
Jazz2015 width label and later height values require follow-up; no imperial fuel/acceleration conversion.
Mass minima are explicitly minimum published configurations; source range and basis retained.
gaps: Full versions remain missing for Civic I–VIII, Accord I–VII and IX–XI, CR-V I–III/V/VI, Jazz I/II, HR-V, e:Ny1, ZR-V, FR-V and older European families.
Many Japan/Asia/US-only families currently have one broad era rather than every generation; Legend/Integra/Shuttle/City need deeper identity and regional-generation work.
Missing regional identities including Inspire, Ballade, Partner, Crider, Envix, Greiz/Gienia, China e:NS2/e:NP2/P7/S7 and 2026 Insight rebadge require a separate verified pass.
Photo searches for modern generations initially used nonexistent category labels; corrected Civic VIII/IX and some later categories searched, not a claim of exhausted Commons coverage.
Historic version tables and full model-specific summaries remain incomplete.

Jazz2015 preliminary height1550 vs later1525 requires body/measurement-scope reconciliation; version height withheld. Exact configuration mass is a preliminary OEM value, not the ADAC EU-driver figure.
